pr_title: catalog/lease: adopt region liveness prober for leasing
pr_body:
This patch will help adopt the regionlivenes framework for the leasing queries responsible for counting descriptors as a part of this work we will:

1. Adopt isql.DB within the leasing framework so that we can run full transactions to count leases per-region
2. Add helpers inside the regionliveness framework for detecting if a database is multi-region aware and refactor some code for cleaner interfaces
3. Modify the regionliveness framework to only set unavailable_at time once inside the system.region_liveness table otherwise risk of stravation exists
4. Adopt this regionliveness information and add support for querying lease counts per region. As a part of this work when regionliveness is enabled the leasing queries will have timeouts which will cause probe queries to occur, so if query a region takes too long, we will next try to detect and mark the region as down.

Fixes: #113162

issue_context.title: catalog/lease: adopt region liveness prober for leasing
issue_context.body:
Modify queries inside leasing, liveness (IsAlive), jobs infrastructure to be invoked per region, and query region liveness and the new setting before accessing these tables. This work will depend on the work from https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/113160, which will introduce a new interface for probing liveness information.

Jira issue: CRDB-32782
Epic [CC-24173](https://cockroachlabs.atlassian.net/browse/CC-24173)

Can we implement WaitForNoVersion by calling CountLeases?
There is a small problem with using the cachedDatabaseRegions. Adding regions is fine, but if a region is removed, the queries will fail once the region is removed from the enum.
